Hi Karan! I’m not able to access real‑time flight data directly, but I can guide you on how to check your Indigo flight status:

1. **Indigo’s Official Website**  
   - Go to [Indigo’s flight status page](https://www.indigo.in/flight-status).  
   - Enter your ticket number (IND4567) or flight number and date.  

2. **Indigo Mobile App**  
   - Open the app, tap “My Bookings,” and select the relevant booking.  
   - The app will show the current status, gate, and any updates.

3. **Flight Tracking Sites**  
   - Websites like [FlightAware](https://flightaware.com/) or [FlightRadar24](https://www.flightradar24.com/) let you search by flight number or tail number.  
   - Just type the flight number (e.g., “IND123”) and you’ll see real‑time tracking.

4. **Contact Customer Support**  
   - Call Indigo’s customer care at 1800-209-9999 (India) or use the chat support on their website for immediate assistance.

If you have any other questions or need help interpreting the status information, feel free to ask!
